query_plans.sql: SELECT claim_id FROM claims WHERE owner='world' AND namespace=? AND status='active' AND instr(lower(subject),?)>0
plan: SEARCH claims USING INDEX idx_recall_claims_scope_status (owner=? AND namespace=? AND status=?)

query_plans.sql: SELECT d.record_id FROM text_recall_fts JOIN text_recall_documents d ON d.doc_id=text_recall_fts.rowid WHERE text_recall_fts MATCH ? AND d.owner='world' AND d.namespace=?
plan: SEARCH d USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
